intro: Second Samuel is the story of King David's reign: his greatest triumphs, and his worst failures.
Chapters one to ten: David becomes king, takes Jerusalem, brings the ark home, and receives God's promise of a lasting kingdom.
Chapters eleven to twenty: his sin with Bathsheba, and the trouble that follows in his own family. Chapters twenty-one to twenty-four close with his songs and final years.
Its author isn't named; it continues First Samuel.
Listen for God's promise to David in chapter seven, and how honestly the Bible tells the story of its heroes.
